title: Artist rendition of dark boomerang-shaped UAV over trees at dusk
description: Digital illustration of a large dark, wide chevron or boomerang-shaped craft hovering low over bare treetops and a rooftop against a gray night sky, bearing a "MUFON [redacted] 4/20/2009" stamp. The caption reads "Artist rendition of the UAV seen by [redacted] - Illustration by [AAP Person 108]." The conclusion text notes the witness wondered if it was a U.S. military aircraft and cites a similar black triangular craft without lights seen in Owings Mills, Maryland, on February 9, 2005; the page ends "Case Report MUFON SIP Deployment CAT 3."
